name: contradiction_pair
description: Q contradicts P; S grounds P. The retraction is of Q, the contradictor, because suppression is directional: asserting the contradiction charges P and leaves Q alone, so only a weakening of Q can refund P. Retracting Q partially (to 0.45) rather than fully is what makes the arms differ in final state: under DIRECT, P is refunded exactly the fraction of the penalty Q no longer justifies; under EVIDENTIAL, P was never charged and never moves.
evidence_count_note: Uniform. P holds its own evidence, so its movement here cannot come from losing grounding — S is untouched throughout.
pricing_note: P holds one evidence record, one supporter and one contradictor, so the contradictor's share is 1/3. At Q's confidence of 0.8 the penalty is 0.2667. No constant is involved.
